name: Orchestrion Piano
summary: Arduino-based acoustic piano concept using PWM-controlled solenoids for up to 88 keys and servos for pedals.
description: The repository documents a configurable full-piano architecture and compiles, but explicitly states that it has not been physically tested.

notes: README describes an Arduino receiving MIDI over USB; exact board variant should be confirmed before construction.

mechanics.summary: One solenoid is mounted under each piano key for direct actuation; three higher-torque servo mechanisms are proposed for the pedals.
notes: README notes that key weighting may need mechanical adjustment.

actuators.notes: Pedal mechanics are proposed rather than validated.

supplies.label: Solenoid supply
supplies.notes: README suggests 24 V solenoids around 5-7 N; supply architecture must be sized to the actual solenoids and concurrency.

notes: High-current design; repository stresses fusing/protection and current distribution across multiple supplies.

warnings: Repository explicitly states that the code compiles but no hardware has been tested.
High-current mains-powered build requires appropriate electrical protection and enclosure design.
